spec.description: Phase-1 OTel Collector load-test: throughput, queues, failures, CPU/memory, and VM ingestion sanity. All signal types stacked.

spec.title: Receiver: accepted vs refused (spans/s)
spec.description: Items/s accepted and refused by all receivers combined.

spec.title: Send failed (after retries) metric points
spec.description: Increase in send failures after retries exhausted per exporter. Non-zero = permanent data loss (H3).

spec.title: Receiver refused rate metric points
spec.description: Receiver refused items due to memory limiter / backpressure.

spec.title: Processor: accepted / refused / dropped (metric points)
spec.description: Processor accepted, refused, and dropped items.

spec.title: Receiver: accepted vs refused (log records/s)
spec.description: Items/s accepted and refused by all receivers combined.

spec.title: Exporter: sent per pipeline (log records/s)
spec.description: Items/s successfully sent per exporter.

spec.title: Enqueue failed (queue full) log records
spec.description: Increase in enqueue failures (queue full) per exporter. Non-zero = hard data loss (H3).

spec.title: Send failed (after retries) log records
spec.description: Increase in send failures after retries exhausted per exporter. Non-zero = permanent data loss (H3).

spec.title: Receiver refused rate log records
spec.description: Receiver refused items due to memory limiter / backpressure.

spec.title: Processor: accepted / refused / dropped (log records)
spec.description: Processor accepted, refused, and dropped items.

spec.title: Queue utilization per exporter (size / capacity)
spec.description: queue_size / queue_capacity per exporter. Above 0.8 for 5+ min = S2 soft limit.

spec.title: Exporter: sent per pipeline (spans/s)
spec.description: Items/s successfully sent per exporter.

spec.title: Queue utilization: max / avg / min across exporters
Collector CPU usage (cores)
spec.description: CPU from otelcol_process_cpu_seconds. Keyed by job, no pod matching.

spec.title: Collector memory: RSS / heap / sys
spec.description: otelcol process RSS, Go heap alloc, and total sys memory.

spec.title: Collector restarts (uptime resets)
spec.description: Restart count derived from otelcol_process_uptime resets. Any increase = the collector restarted (H2). Does not require kube-state/cAdvisor.

spec.title: Batch processor: avg batch size and timeout sends
spec.description: Batch processor avg send size and rate of timeout-triggered flushes.

spec.title: VM backend: rows inserted/s
spec.description: Rows inserted/s into the load-test VM backend.

spec.title: VM backend: OTLP HTTP requests and errors
spec.description: OTLP HTTP request rate and error rate at the VM backend.

spec.title: VM backend: pending rows and active merges
spec.description: Pending rows and active merges. High pending rows = VM backend is the bottleneck.

spec.description: Increase in enqueue failures (queue full) per exporter. Non-zero = hard data loss (H3).

spec.description: Processor accepted, refused, and dropped items.

spec.description: Items/s successfully sent per exporter.
